theorem: If the actual special-fiber complete local ring has finite length ell, the characteristic-zero origin complete local ring has length at most ell. Exact equality of two consecutive actual truncated dimensions certifies the finite special length.
proof_steps: explicit topological Nakayama gives at most ell generators over Z_p
integrality makes all v_i nilpotent in Q_p[[v]]/(f)
surjection from B[1/p] bounds the origin length
rational finite-jet matrix ranks are unchanged by Q to Q_p extension
does_not_claim: equality of generic and special length
verification of a particular flag70 or T5 numerical bound
